inference: For each tree, walk feature<=threshold ? left : right to a leaf, read its `probs` vector (indexed by `classes`), average probs across all trees -> final class-probability vector. n_trees=400 -- exported JSON size and per-window latency for this scale are in the accompanying results row, not assumed.

feature_normalization.description: Per task: z-score each raw feature using mean/std from sliding windows in [task_start, task_start+acclimation_ms) only, then apply pipeline scaler.

selection_metadata.selection_rationale: median heldout_auc across non-degenerate model families at each window/step config; see grid_search_results.csv and WINDOW/STEP ROBUSTNESS CHECK

firing_policy.selection_rule: maximize pct_tasks_fired subject to false_fire_rate <= 30%, break ties by median_lead_time_s
